issues.description: `CursorKind` is a proof-only model enum but is declared as an ordinary enum instead of a ghost type.
issues.rationale: CursorKind is only carried by ghost/tracked embedding state and has no executable role. The maintainer explicitly requested making it a ghost type; the next commit changes it to `pub ghost enum CursorKind`, and the final review was approved. This is a verified model-type classification issue, not a runtime semantic failure.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Confirmed proof-only uses, maintainer request, and the immediate ghost-enum fix in commit 96e04e705b5d1a6932391f22352d12a979ec2ee2.
